summary: Case case_27 (ananya-nair@gmail.com, user_27). Four resources in evidence_92 (captured 2026-09-15, before audit_at) tie to user_27: backup_5970 (blocked), data_flow_2295 (disabled), audit_record_3830 (retained until 2034), and support_4707 (redacted to user_reference only). No primary USER_PROFILE, SECONDARY_IDENTIFIER, search, cache, export or marketing record for user_27 was found in usable evidence. Searches on the email and name returned nothing, and the other "Ananya" records belong to different people. The shared-batch candidates (account_3866, account_5482, account_7012, analytics_4574, analytics_6077) were rejected as identity-free or claim-only. The workflow's COMPLETE status is only partly supported: the subject-linked residue is treated, disabled or blocked, and the retained audit record is correctly kept. No evidence shows a live primary account or copy of the subject's data at audit_at. Confirmation of full removal is therefore supported only for the records that were found.
